7. **Save-on-blur:** triggers `<SaveIndicator>`. Debounce logic doesn't drop writes. Handles PATCH errors (rollback or toast).
8. **Breadcrumb integration:** `Settings › Group › Section` renders on every settings page.
9. **Orphan cleanup:** old `page.tsx` files that just redirect — are they still in the tree? Bundle delta.
10. **Bundle cumulative delta** vs Sprint 1 baseline.

## Output
`.handoffs/sage-sprint-14-review.md`. Verdict + findings + scores + cumulative bundle delta. 150-word return summary.

4	
5	export type AutoSaveStatus = 'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'error'
6	
7	interface UseDebouncedAutoSaveOptions<T> {
8	  /** Async save function. Receives the current form value. Throws on failure. */
9	  onSave: (value: T) => Promise<void>
10	  /** Debounce delay in ms. Default: 800. */
11	  delay?: number
12	}
13	
14	interface UseDebouncedAutoSaveReturn<T> {
15	  status: AutoSaveStatus
16	  lastSavedAt: Date | null
17	  /** Call on every field change. Schedules a debounced save. */
18	  handleChange: (value: T) => void
19	  /** Call on field blur for immediate save (cancels pending debounce). */
20	  handleBlur: (value: T) => Promise<void>
21	}
22	
23	export function useDebouncedAutoSave<T>({
24	  onSave,
25	  delay = 800,
26	}: UseDebouncedAutoSaveOptions<T>): UseDebouncedAutoSaveReturn<T> {
27	  const [status, setStatus] = useState<AutoSaveStatus>('idle')
28	  const [lastSavedAt, setLastSavedAt] = useState<Date | null>(null)
29	  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)
30	
31	  const save = useCallback(
32	    async (value: T) => {
33	      setStatus('saving')
34	      try {
35	        await onSave(value)
36	        setStatus('saved')
37	        setLastSavedAt(new Date())
38	      } catch {
39	        setStatus('error')
40	      }
41	    },
42	    [onSave],
43	  )
44	
45	  const handleChange = useCallback(
46	    (value: T) => {
47	      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current)
48	      timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
49	        void save(value)
50	      }, delay)
51	    },
52	    [save, delay],
53	  )
54	
55	  const handleBlur = useCallback(
56	    async (value: T) => {
57	      if (timerRef.current) {
58	        clearTimeout(timerRef.current)
59	        timerRef.current = null
60	      }
61	      await save(value)
62	    },
63	    [save],
64	  )
65	
66	  return { status, lastSavedAt, handleChange, handleBlur }
